test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: MRCS is related to PUFV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, VOLG is related to YROJ. To which of the given options is SHIM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, MRCS is related to PUFV

M (13) → P (16) : +3

R (18) → U (21) : +3

C (3) → F (6) : +3

S (19) → V (22) : +3

For, 'VOLG is related to YROJ

V (22) → Y (25) : +3

O (15) → R (18) : +3

L (12) → O (15) : +3

G (7) → J (10) : +3

Similarly, **SHIM **related to **VKLP.**

S (19) → 19 + 3 = 22 → **V**

H (8) → 8 + 3 = 11 → **K**

I (9) → 9 + 3 = 12 → **L**

M (13) → 13 + 3 = 16 → **P**

So, **SHIM** will be related to **VKLP.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
